scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend && cp -Rf frontend/dist/* backend/dist
scripts.test:integration:docker: docker-compose -f docker-compose-test.yaml down --remove-orphans --volumes && docker-compose -f docker-compose-test.yaml up --build --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from tests --remove-orphans ; docker-compose -f docker-compose-test.yaml down --remove-orphans --volumes
